misconceptions.description: Treating all errors as equally costly.
misconceptions.trigger: learner reports only overall error rate
misconceptions.feedback: False positives and false negatives harm different people in different ways. Ask who pays for each.

misconceptions.description: Assuming any human in the loop is enough.
misconceptions.trigger: learner says 'a person signs off, so it is fine'
misconceptions.feedback: A reviewer needs time, information and permission to overrule the tool, or oversight is only a formality.
